key_gap: On the orchard frost-protection decision (need +2.0 °C above a -2 °C blossom threshold for 6 h; each fan plume +0.7 °C, rises additive at >=3 overlapping plumes; in-domain options all below threshold: heater +0.3 °C, sprinklers 40% twig breakage, wind machine +0.4 °C), the AI generated its entire alternative space inside the problem's own vocabulary (heating / coverage / accept-loss) and certified a 60-75% expected crop loss as APPROXIMATED, while the human abstracted the problem to its relations (threshold at target; individually sub-threshold units; path-harm bound; arrival-additivity), recognized the converging-forces structure (fortress siege / radiation beams / phased array), mapped >=5 explicit correspondences, and transferred the convergence relation: 4 fans on 4 ridgelines converging on the basin give +2.8 °C (canopy -1.2 °C), forest unharmed (+0.7 °C <= +1.0 °C bound), 8 of 24 crew-hours. The additivity fact was in the AI's own evidence set and no alternative was ever generated in which >=3 plumes overlap - the AI verified correctly the options it listed and never generated the option class that wins.
learning_signal: Cross-domain novelty is a generation-time property, not an evaluation-time one: before finalizing the alternative set, run a structure-mapping pass that (a) abstracts the problem to its relations (thresholds, superposition/additivity, path-harm bounds, constraints), (b) asks what known solved situations share that relation skeleton (here: converging-forces family), and (c) transfers the relations, not the objects - then verifies the transfer against the given numbers. The mapping is gradeable: correspondence count, relation-level (not object-level) transfer, and the recomputed arithmetic (need +2.0 °C; 3 plumes +2.1 °C thin margin -> choose 4 for +2.8 °C; per-plume +0.7 °C below the +1.0 °C harm bound; crew budget) all check out. The AAR tell is diagnostic: the trace's own 'unexamined option class' note (an additivity fact in evidence with no arrangement using it) marks the missing generation step - a candidate that is never enumerated cannot be verified.
suggested_improvement: Add a HOW-stage structure-mapping pre-filter, run once between framing (WHAT) and finalizing the alternative list: (1) abstract the problem to its load-bearing relations; (2) name 1-3 known situations with the same relation skeleton; (3) if any exists, generate at least one alternative by transferring its relations and verify it against the task's numbers; if none exists, record the abstraction and why no known situation matches. Gate: the trace must show either an explicit cross-domain candidate considered and verified, or a written justification (with the abstraction named) for not transferring. Cheap to run (one mapping table), and it converts the existing alternatives step from domain-bounded enumeration into cross-domain generation; also serve it as a REVIEW checklist item - 'did the final alternative space include any candidate generated from a structure outside the task's vocabulary?'

key_gap: On the 'Project Hive' architecture decision (stigmergy proposal citing bee colonies; Pilot A: 40% scheduling-latency win on placement; extended pilot: 11% inconsistent order confirmations from contradictory local decisions; source facts: bees never agree about a specific item, are expendable, allocate aggregate effort; target: durable, externally-visible obligations, fined twice), the pure analogical style was trapped by a partially-true analogy: it built a rich surface mapping (workers-nodes, pheromones-local metrics, comb-racks, robustness-fault tolerance), used the genuine placement correspondence (Pilot A's 40%) to license wholesale transfer, re-framed the extended-pilot mechanism (contradictory local decisions) as adaptation noise plus self-healing proof (retries), and recommended deleting the consensus layer - institutionalizing an observed 11% contradiction rate on a regulatory-exposed path. The blinded AI screened the mapping's load-bearing relation before transferring: the target requires agreement between agents about specific durable obligations; the source domain contains no such relation (no per-item agreement, expendability, aggregate-only decisions); the extended-pilot mechanism is that missing relation failing in vivo - so it rejected wholesale transfer and selected the bounded one: stigmergy only where no agreement is required (placement), consensus retained on durable paths.
learning_signal: For evaluating a proposed analogy, treat 'the analogy is partially true' as the default hypothesis, not 'true' or 'false': (1) identify the target's load-bearing relations - the ones whose failure breaks the goal (here: agreement about specific durable obligations); (2) check each against the source domain's own guarantees (the proposal's bee facts: no per-item agreement, expendability, aggregate allocation); (3) a load-bearing relation with no counterpart in the source disqualifies wholesale transfer and *delimits* it - salvage exactly the sub-correspondence that does hold (placement: no cross-node agreement needed, matching Pilot A's 40% win); (4) treat task-embedded pilot/experiment data as first-class falsifiers of the transfer, mechanism-level not outcome-level (the 11% mechanism is the missing relation failing, not noise to explain away - retries repaired data after the customer saw the contradiction, so self-healing does not substitute for agreement). A flat rejection of the analogy is as wrong as wholesale adoption: the rubric rewards the bounded transfer with the boundary stated.
suggested_improvement: Add an analogy/pattern screening gate at the WHY/HOW boundary, triggered whenever the task contains (or the agent proposes) a transferred pattern: (1) extract the target's load-bearing relations from its requirements; (2) for each, check the source domain's guarantees from its own stated facts; (3) if any load-bearing relation lacks a counterpart, reject wholesale transfer and name the mapping's boundary in the decision packet, transferring only the corresponding subset; (4) treat pilot/experimental data embedded in the task as falsifiers of the transfer (use the mechanism, not just the outcome rate); (5) add to REVIEW the question 'was any proposed pattern transferred beyond its structural boundary?' - and cross-link with the POS signal's structure-mapping pre-filter: the AI's screening is evidence-based and strong (this case), while its generation of cross-domain candidates is the weak side (m026-POS-01); the two gates together give the agent both the generative and the evaluative half of analogical competence.
